title: An acetylcholine-inhibited sleep-active hippocampal interneuron orchestrates memory consolidation
title_zh: 一种乙酰胆碱抑制的睡眠活跃海马抑制神经元调控记忆巩固
abstract: Memory reactivation during hippocampal ripples is critical for sleep-dependent memory consolidation. However, the molecular-to-circuit mechanism enabling sleep-predominant ripple generation remains unresolved. Here, we discovered that a sparse population of GABAergic interneurons in the mouse hippocampus specializes in gating ripple generation and memory consolidation. While all known genetically labeled hippocampal interneurons were highly active during wakefulness and rapid-eye-movement (REM) sleep, genetic targeting of M2 acetylcholine receptor (Chrm2)-expressing neurons isolated a specific population preferentially active during non-REM (NREM) sleep and quiet wakefulness. These acetylcholine-inhibited interneurons inhibited the entire hippocampus in an infra-slow rhythm (∼0.015 Hz). Suppressing their activity in dorsal CA3 or ventral hippocampus impaired spatial and social memory, respectively. Furthermore, Chrm2+ neurons were closely associated with ripples; their activity bidirectionally modulated ripple occurrence via widespread inhibition. Thus, Chrm2+ interneurons are critical in linking neuromodulatory state to memory consolidation, offering genetically targeted access to sleep-active memory circuits implicated in cognitive disorders.
abstract_zh: 在海马颤动期间的记忆再激活对睡眠依赖的记忆巩固至关重要。然而，促使睡眠主导颤动产生的分子到电路机制尚未阐明。我们发现，鼠海马中一小部分GABA能抑制神经元专门负责调节颤动生成和记忆巩固。所有已知的基因标记海马抑制神经元在清醒和快速眼动（REM）睡眠期间均高度活跃，而对M2乙酰胆碱受体（Chrm2）表达神经元的基因靶向则分离出一特定群体，主要在非快速眼动（NREM）睡眠和安静清醒期间活跃。这些乙酰胆碱抑制的抑制神经元以低频节律（≈0.015 Hz）抑制整个海马。抑制它们在背侧CA3或腹侧海马的活动分别导致空间记忆和社会记忆受损。此外，Chrm2+神经元与颤动密切相关；其活动通过广泛抑制双向调节颤动的发生。因此，Chrm2+抑制神经元在将神经调节状态与记忆巩固联系起来方面至关重要，为涉及认知障碍的睡眠活跃记忆电路提供了基因靶向的通路。
